reviews.text: I’ve been taking my dog Gio there for already almost 4 years.  Great service!
A nightmare for my cat. Never again. The lady who did the grooming also sent us away during the cut and wasn't nice to our cat at all. Not recommended for this grooming salon.

Very poorly done, and I forgot to do the paws.

Only the tangles were supposed to be removed. When I get my cat back, she'll be completely shaved.
And her mucus/hair will also be shaved short.

It's so sad that I have to get my cat back like this!
€75 for something like that... I'll never do that again!
Ridiculous!!!! I'll never come back here again.

Yesterday I went to this salon with my dog ​​Mokka. He was groomed very nicely and I am very satisfied. He also had an infected eye and I was recommended eye ointment; they also have a pet shop. The eye ointment works very well; after just one day there is no more pus in his eye.

Skilled and kind are the words I would use to describe this place. Lovely groomers who are very skilled. We are already entrusting our second dog to them, and although he has a different coat, nothing but compliments.
Besides being a groomer, also a good pet store
Absolutely terrible. Smelly and unclean. Owner extremely rude and unhelpful. Terrible all round. Save your time and go elsewhere.
Great salon for my dogs. They have both been coming here since they were puppies and look fantastic, but they also always feel happy. Mandy is sweet to them and a good groomer.
Service perfect, as always at La Chic
Both my labradoodles love this place. We come here regularly for a cut or just wash and brush and the dogs are never stressed and look like film starts when they leave 🐕🐕 …
My little dog looks great again.
